newsitem.title: USA: Iowa soybean harvest nearly complete, corn active.
newsitem.headline: Iowa soybean harvest nearly complete, corn active.

text.p: Soybean harvesting in Iowa was nearly complete as of Sunday and aggressive combining of corn saw over 90 percent of the corn crop "in the bin," according to the Iowa Agricultural Statistics Service.
Soybean harvest was 99 percent done, slightly behind 100 percent of a year ago and 100 percent average.
Corn harvest was 91 percent complete, lagging 100 percent a year ago but even with the 91 percent average.
Topsoil moisture was rated one percent very short, six percent short, 80 percent adequate and 13 percent surplus.
Subsoil moisture was one percent very short, 18 percent short, 76 percent adequate and five percent surplus.
Fall tillage for 1997 row crops was 33 percent complete as of Sunday. Last year, producers had tilled 41 percent of the intended 1996 row crop acres and normal for this time of year is 36 percent.
